personal.bio: I am Associate Architect at EY, with 10+ years in software architecture and data engineering. I embed with teams to turn ambiguous business problems into production AI systems — moving fast from prototype to scale, close to users and real constraints. My focus is agentic orchestration and applied AI, working with Camunda 8.8, Azure OpenAI, AutoGen, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP), and I'm currently building an enterprise-grade agentic orchestration tool with Spring AI and MCP as a personal project. My breadth runs from AI-driven microservices and reactive data platforms to designing and operating multi-agent systems for intelligent automation.

contact.heading: Let's work together.
contact.subtitle: I'm always interested in new opportunities and exciting projects. Feel free to reach out if you'd like to collaborate or just say hello.
